text: On 12 August, pump P-104 experienced excessive vibration near its motor bearing. The technician replaced the bearing and tested the equipment successfully.
Pump P-104 experienced excessive vibration around the motor bearing. The bearing was replaced and the pump was tested.
Motor overheated during operation. Tripped on thermal protection. Allowed to cool and restarted.
Excessive temperature observed in the motor assembly of compressor C-210. Cooling fan found clogged with dust and cleaned.
Motor temperature was above the normal range on conveyor drive M-33. Checked load, within limits. Greased the drive-end bearing.
14/03/2024 - Motor M-07 running hot, winding temp 118C vs normal 85C. Cooling fins blocked. Cleaned fins, temp back to 82C.
Operator reported the motor on fan F-12 is overheating and showing abnormal vibration. Bearing worn, replaced.
Motor casing too hot to touch near the terminal box. Loose connection tightened. Temperature normal after 2 hours.
Chgd brg on P-104 mtr. Vib high before, ok after. Lube'd and tested.
Cmpr C-210 hi temp alarm. Chkd oil lvl, topped up. Rstrt ok.
Repl. seal on pmp P-220 - leaking at shaft. Press test OK.
Vib on M-33 drv end brg. Adj. coupling alignment, re-chk tmrw.
HX-5 fouled, dP up. Cleaned tubes. Dp now nrml.
Inspected pump P-104. No leak found. Bearing was not replaced as vibration is within limits.
Motor M-07 did not overheat during the 4 hour run. No abnormal noise. Filter not changed.
Seal on P-220 not leaking after the repair. Without vibration or excess temperature at the bearing.
Checked for cracks on the impeller of P-104, none observed. Replacement not required.
Operator suspected overheating but motor temperature was not above normal. No action taken.
Replaced the bearing.
Pump making noise. Looked at it.
Equipment 4 tripped yesterday. Reset.
Valve V-18 stuck.
Pump P-104 and P-105 both showed vibration. Bearing replaced on one of them.
Replaced the burnt-out lamps in the north stairwell and checked the emergency lighting.
Quarterly fire extinguisher inspection completed on level 2. All tags updated.
Painted the safety lines in the loading bay. Area closed until Friday.
Cleaned the cafeteria extraction hood filters and replaced the door closer on the west entrance.
Conveyor belt B-09 mistracking to the left. Adjusted the tail pulley and re-tensioned the belt.
Compressor C-210 discharge pressure low. Replaced the inlet valve reed. Pressure restored to 8 bar.
Gearbox GB-4 oil leak at output shaft seal. Seal replaced, oil topped up, no leak after 24 h.
Pump P-104 bearing temperature alarm again, second time this month. Checked lubrication, regreased. Monitoring.
